scope: Anomaly inquiry (detect, test hypotheses against the data, ask a named person for a one-sentence answer) and human-approved healing re-applied before every engine. Nothing is removed, and nothing changes without an answer.
business_logic_change_note: No engine, rule, grade or authority changed. A new tolerant stage 21 applies only repairs a person approved (none by default; then the mart differs only by an empty HEALED_FIELDS column). A new tolerant stage 96 detects anomalies and writes questions to extras and the trust snapshot. All 1426 pre-existing tests unchanged and green; 40 new tests.
key_changes: gsi/trust/anomaly.py: VALUE_OUTLIER, CATEGORY_VARIANT, NEW_CATEGORY, VOLUME_DROP, TOO_GOOD at entity grain, each with evidence-ranked hypotheses; 'it is real' always offered and leads on ties
gsi/trust/inquiry.py: append-only answer register in wh_audit; every answer needs a name and a sentence; 'we don't know' capped at 30 days then overdue; revoke instead of delete; CLI

gsi/stages/s21_heal.py: approved RESCALE/ALIAS repairs applied after derive and before every engine, bound to the exact approved value, with HEALED_FIELDS provenance; keys and computed outputs never healed
gsi/stages/s96_anomaly.py: detection after the trust stage; per-run observations (source volumes, coverage, totals, vocabularies) stored in the trust snapshot so the next run can compare
app/trust_view.py: new tab «ناهنجاری‌ها — اول بپرس» with hypothesis cards, before/after repair preview, answer form, revoke and full answer history
gsi/trust/trend.load_payloads(): raw stored summaries for detectors that need more than the trend row

validation.negative_tests: Key-column guard and value-binding guard each removed in turn; the corresponding test failed both times, then passed with the guard restored
validation.pipeline_verification: Demo snapshot: approval recorded in the warehouse, next pipeline run rescaled exactly that case (417,130 → 417.13) before any engine, HEALED_FIELDS on that row only, row count unchanged
validation.visual_verification: New tab driven in a real browser: empty answer refused and not recorded, named approval recorded, card moved to 'repair approved', revoke and history appeared; one real detection gap (unit slip at the edge of the normal band) found from the render and fixed with a test that fails on the old rule

production_certification_reason: Inherited from 29.9.0: real corporate workbooks and Windows/SMB/Outlook acceptance were not available in this environment, and two emergency rules expired 2026-09-22 await an official successor decision. The trust layer itself is additive and does not change that status.

previous_release.scope: Visual redesign of the offline HTML report only: journey breadcrumb, KPI status stickers, panel accents, wrapped/chip-friendly table cells, coverage meter bars. No computation, algorithm, or business rule changed anywhere in the package.
previous_release.business_logic_change_note: Only three presentation files changed: gsi/design/css.py, gsi/design/components.py, and the template/CSS/client-rendering portions of gsi/studio_core/html_export.py. Every number, grade, and warning text in the exported HTML is byte-identical to 29.13.0; only how it is drawn changed. 1426 tests pass — the same count as 29.13.0.
key_changes: Journey breadcrumb (.flow-step) restyled as tilted, dashed-arrow-connected sticky-note steps; current stage gets a pin
app_bar() KPI stickers take their colour from T.STATUS_BY_LABEL when the stat label matches a known status — a lookup on existing audited tokens, nothing computed
.process-viz panels get a teal edge accent consistent with the app bar

Table cells wrap instead of forcing single-line horizontal scroll; a warning cell already delimited by '؛' renders as short chips, but only when clauses are short enough that chipping actually helps (verified by screenshotting a regression and narrowing the rule)
Coverage KPI cards (row/column count) get a meter bar restating the same two numbers already shown as text
Design direction prototyped in Figma first (sticky-note cards, dashed connectors, stamp badges, meter bars) using GSI's own audited brand colors, then ported as inline offline CSS/SVG

validation.this_release_result: 1426 passed, 0 failed — identical count, confirming no computation moved
